page_title: LEN 1-0 STR | Lens v Strasbourg 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Jerome Brisard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The foul by Emmanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jerome Brisard.
90+5' Florian Sotoca (Lens) receives a yellow card from the referee for dissent.
90+5' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) is given a red card by referee Jerome Brisard and leaves his team a man down.
90+1' Jean-Marc Kuentz has decided to substitute Guela Doue and he is replaced by Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
90+1' Neat passing move from Lens in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

84' Strasbourg keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.

77' The referee gives a yellow card to Adrien Thomasson (Lens) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
77' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) brings down his opponent with a horror tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
76' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

61' That's the end of the game for Samir El Mourabet, who is replaced by Mathis Amougou (Strasbourg).
61' Jean-Marc Kuentz decides to make a substitution. Felix Lemarechal will be replaced by Julio Enciso (Strasbourg).
59' There's an opportunity for Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
56' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
53' Strasbourg are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Strasbourg.
52' The Strasbourg players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
49' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
49' Florian Thauvin (Lens) extricates himself from the difficult situation with a good pass, comfortably eluding the pressing opponent.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jean-Marc Kuentz gives a chance to Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) and Lucas Hogsberg is off.
46' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A player from Lens commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Dangerous play by Ruben Aguilar (Lens). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
41' The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
41' Great save! Emmanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Robin Risser.
40' Shots on target – 1:0.
37' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
33' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. It's a free kick to Strasbourg, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
32' A pass by Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
30' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. One of the players from Strasbourg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
28' Robin Risser (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
26' 54:46 – the latest ball possession ratio.
25' Lens hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
21' The Strasbourg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Strasbourg players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
15' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) and Mike Penders matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
14' Strasbourg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
12' Emmanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

10' Emmanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
10' Samson Baidoo (Lens) and Malang Sarr perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
9' Great teamplay by Lens as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Mike Penders (Strasbourg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
3' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) is booked.
